s5.p8: And here we can see how context passing works during assignment:
s5.p9: ![ico-20 pin] if there is a **regular function** on the right-hand side of the assignment statement, it receives a reference to the call context defined on the **left-hand side** of the assignment statement (in our example, this is the object **⟦f7⟧**);
